title: Lion
text: Maasai Mara's lions are Kenya's pride. Watch them hunt at sunrise or nap under acacia trees,an unforgettable moment in the heart of Africa.

title: Leopard
text: In Kenya’s Samburu or Laikipia, spot leopards draped in trees. Their stealth and beauty make every rare sighting a true safari treasure.

title: African Elephant
text: Amboseli elephants roam with Mt. Kilimanjaro in view. Witness Kenya’s largest herds walking proudly through golden grasslands and swamps.

title: Rhinocerous
text: Kenya leads in rhino conservation. Meet black and white rhinos in Ol Pejeta or Nairobi Park, where ancient wildlife meets modern protection.

title: Cape Buffalo
text: Kenya’s Cape buffaloes roam Tsavo and Meru in massive herds. Strong, alert, and untamed,they add power to your safari adventure.
